description: Legal benchmark FENs for comparing Stockfish browser analysis at depths 10, 12, and 16. Forced-mate expectations are asserted; non-forced positions are observational and used for depth-stability and runtime comparisons.

cases.reason: White queen on g6 can play Qg7# with king support.
Record whether best move and score vary across depths; multiple opening moves are reasonable.
Quiet middlegame position for measuring best-move and evaluation stability without a forced tactical answer.
Black-to-move middlegame checks perspective handling and depth stability.
Clearly winning queen-versus-pawns position without an immediate mate, used to test whether depth 10 preserves the same strategic conclusion as 12 and 16.
Low-material endgame broadens the benchmark beyond openings, middlegames, and immediate mates.
Balanced queenless middlegame for testing move-choice stability when there is no obvious forcing line.
Black-to-move defensive position checks whether deeper search changes the recommended defensive move.
Tactical heavy-piece position intended to stress shallow search without hard-coding an unverified best move.
